wave: the incremental quality of compressed continuation on the already-quantised execution, judged on a held-out bank
status: FORECAST — frozen before implementation; the execution record goes in continuation-codec-2-notes.json and this file is not edited
question: When codec/v1 (4-bit) replaces exact K/V on the Q4_K-weight execution LARQL already ships, does it materially worsen that execution's agreement with the full-precision reference?
why: CONTINUATION-CODEC-1 closed quality UNINFORMATIVE, residency ESTABLISHED (continuation-codec-1-notes.json, closure): its yardstick C agreed with R on top-1 at 0.796 against an unmeasured 0.90 floor, and its rule mixed a yardstick-relative mean/tail with an absolute confident band C itself cannot meet. CODEC-1 is preserved as run. CODEC-2 is a successor with a better-decomposed question, not an amendment. Its reconnaissance (docs/continuation-codec-2-reconnaissance.md) calibrated R↔C on CODEC-1's bank from the C records only and sized the paired test

decomposition.A_calibration: is C a usable baseline — R ↔ C; a narrow guard, not a verdict
decomposition.B_verdict: the incremental damage KV compression adds to the already-quantised execution — C ↔ CH, both scored against R on the same positions, paired
decomposition.isolated_codec: codec damage on full-precision weights — R ↔ H; reported, not adjudicated
decomposition.end_to_end: the deployed system (Q4_K weights + compressed K/V) — R ↔ CH; reported, not adjudicated
decomposition.why_CH_not_H_for_B: in CODEC-1, H ran the codec on the full-precision container, so C ↔ H compared two different approximations side by side. The incremental question needs the codec STACKED on the quantised execution: CH. Decided by the maintainer at freeze

contamination_boundary.known_at_freeze: CODEC-1's pooled H (4-bit on f32) and H3 results on bank 1 are known to the designer: KL mean 0.067 / 0.202, p99 0.97 / 1.97, top-1 0.898 / 0.822 against C's 0.243 / 2.36 / 0.796. No per-position H or H3 record was opened, and no paired H−C statistic was computed
contamination_boundary.not_known_at_freeze: no arm has run on bank 2; no CH result exists beyond P0a-CH's 8 bank-1 positions
contamination_boundary.consequence: the verdict is taken on bank 2 only. δ comes from the reconnaissance's power table; ε, the tail factor and the band threshold are stated principles relative to C measured in the same run, not values tuned to any H result. Bank 1 is calibration only

baseline.provider: codec/v1 (larql-kv vindex3/codec.rs): encode-once TurboQuant per head_dim block, one per-layer decode scratch behind prepare_layer, retention = window/v1's; ABI larql-plugin/5
baseline.instrument: the MEM-1 harness's CODEC-1 C3 modules (codec_1_c3.rs, codec_1_c3_run.rs): pointer-level codec residency, NULL/yardstick/bank guards, resumable checkpoints stamped with four authorities. They stay untouched as the record of what CODEC-1 ran
baseline.residency: ESTABLISHED by CODEC-1; not re-adjudicated here

arms.R: reference: row/v1 on gemma3-4b-it.vindex3 (full-precision weights, BF16 decoder stack as bound by a plain open)
arms.NULL: window/v1 on the same container; must be bit-identical to R (KL 0, same top-1 at every scored position)
arms.C: row/v1 on gemma3-4b-it.q4k.vindex3 opened for the Q4_K pack; admissible only if its recorded selection binds target.decoder_stack → Q4_K, stored, Q4_K rev 1
arms.CH: the candidate: codec/v1 bits 4 on the SAME Q4_K-bound store as C, with the same selection guard
arms.H: codec/v1 bits 4 on the full-precision container; reported (isolated codec damage), not adjudicated
arms.dropped: H3 (3-bit) is not run: CODEC-1 measured its residency; its quality is a later rung if CH holds

acceptance.text: the frozen held-out bank continuation-codec-2-token-bank.json (8,193 IDs, sha256 5120445c… over u32 LE; The Warden, Trollope, Gutenberg #619, passage committed beside it) is the authority: every arm consumes exactly those IDs, digest verified at load; an arm fed any other sequence is inadmissible
acceptance.scored_positions: rungs 2,048, 4,096 and 8,192 total positions; each journey is prefill n − 1,040, resume 16, decode 1,024, and every decode step's full logit row is scored teacher-forced (position start + i predicts ID start + i + 1). 3 × 1,024 = 3,072 scored positions. The 1,024 rung of CODEC-1 is not used: it cannot hold 1,024 decode positions after its resume. Rung is confounded with text (each rung scores a different passage); per-rung results are findings, never a length law
acceptance.metric: represent/measure/plan/metrics.rs position_metrics, unchanged, over the FULL logit width (262,208): per position KL(R‖·) in f64 nats, top-1 agreement with R, R's margin (top-1 minus top-2 probability). Every scored arm is scored against R

guards.rule: any guard failure makes the run UNINFORMATIVE, not a pass and not a fail
guards.bank: every arm consumes bank 2 (digest verified at load)
guards.null: NULL is KL 0 with the same top-1 at every scored position of every rung
guards.bindings: C and CH recorded selections bind the Q4_K pack; R, NULL and H bind the full-precision stack
guards.A_yardstick_usable: pooled over the three rungs: top-1 agreement(R, C) ≥ 0.70 AND mean KL(R‖C) ≤ 0.50 nats. Its job is narrow — C is not so broken that an incremental comparison is meaningless. Bank 1 measured 0.796 [0.775, 0.816] and 0.243 [0.201, 0.289]; the bounds sit far outside those intervals so an ordinary text passes and a broken yardstick does not
guards.residency_regression: CH's and H's codec residency equals the declared formula exactly at every rung end (CODEC-1's equation, 0 strays, scratch within bound); a failure stops the run as a provider or instrument fault

rule.subject: CH is ACCEPTABLE only if every guard passes and B1–B4 all hold, pooled over the three rungs (n = 3,072 paired positions); NOT ACCEPTABLE if any adjudicated rule fails; otherwise (a guard failed, or B4 lacks support and B1–B3 hold) UNINFORMATIVE. Each rule is also reported per rung; a rung that fails a rule the pool passes is recorded as a finding, not smoothed
rule.B1_top1_noninferiority: with b = #positions where CH agrees with R and C does not, c = #positions where C agrees and CH does not: diff = (b − c)/n, se = sqrt((b + c) − (b − c)²/n)/n, lower = diff − 1.6449 × se. HOLDS iff lower ≥ −δ, δ = 0.03 (reconnaissance power table: δ = 0.03 at 80% power needs ≤ 3,072 positions for discordance up to ~0.45)
rule.B2_kl_mean_noninferiority: d_i = KL(R‖CH)_i − KL(R‖C)_i. Upper = the 95th percentile, over the stratified bootstrap replicates, of the replicate's mean of d. HOLDS iff upper ≤ ε, ε = 0.25 × pooled mean KL(R‖C) of the same run (point estimate) — compression may add at most a quarter of the damage weight quantisation already adds
rule.B3_tail: the PAIRED incremental tail, on the same d_i as B2 (the reconnaissance: a tail rule is stated on paired quantities, not on two separately computed p99s). Upper = the 95th percentile, over the same stratified bootstrap replicates, of the replicate's nearest-rank p99 of d. HOLDS iff upper ≤ 0.25 × pooled nearest-rank p99 KL(R‖C) of the same run (point estimate) — at the 99th percentile of incremental damage, compression adds no more than a quarter of C's existing p99 error
rule.B4_confident_band: B1's paired McNemar bound restricted to the positions where R's margin ≥ 0.9 (n_conf of them): with b, c counted within the band, lower = (b − c)/n_conf − 1.6449 × sqrt((b + c) − (b − c)²/n_conf)/n_conf. Minimum support N_MIN = 350: if n_conf < 350, B4 is UNINFORMATIVE (and so is an otherwise-passing verdict); else B4 HOLDS iff lower ≥ −δ. N_MIN is the positions a δ = 0.03 non-inferiority test needs at 80% power for band discordance up to 0.05 — about 5× C's own in-band flip rate on bank 1 (0.011); bank 1's band share (24.3%) projects ~750 band positions at 3,072. The band is relative to C: on bank 1, C scores 0.989 there, and no absolute bar near 0.995 is reachable by C on any band
rule.bootstrap: B2 and B3 share one STRATIFIED block bootstrap. Each rung's 1,024 scored positions form 32 non-overlapping blocks of 32 consecutive positions (block length from the reconnaissance). Every replicate samples, with replacement, exactly 32 blocks from rung 2,048, 32 from rung 4,096 and 32 from rung 8,192, and pools the resulting 3,072 positions — the rungs are different passages, and the experiment fixes each at one third, so no replicate may reweight them. 10,000 replicates, driven by SplitMix64 seeded 0xC0DEC2, so every bound is reproducible

reported_not_adjudicated: R ↔ H: KL mean/p50/p99/max, top-1, per rung and per margin band (isolated codec damage on full-precision weights)
R ↔ CH the same (end-to-end deployed system)
KL(C‖CH) per position — what compression changes relative to the quantised execution itself (needs C's decode logits kept per rung, like R's)
the B statistics per rung; McNemar's b and c
wall time per arm, under MEM-1 instrumentation — not a decode-cost measurement
acceptance.reading: a pass says: on this held-out text, 4-bit compressed continuation does not materially worsen the shipped Q4_K execution's agreement with the full-precision reference, by the margins above. It is not a losslessness claim, not an absolute fidelity number (PARITY-FLOOR-1 is open), not a claim about H3, other models or other texts, and not a decode-cost claim

anti_cheat: the rule, δ, ε, the tail factor, the band threshold, the block length, the stratification, the seed, N_MIN and the bank are fixed here; none is changed after any bank-2 arm runs. A failed guard is UNINFORMATIVE and is not re-run with altered bounds — a new question is a new freeze. CH and C share one store and one prepared operand set, so they differ only in the continuation provider. codec/v1 is not changed between freeze and run

scope.in: a CODEC-2 run module in the MEM-1 harness (bank 2 authority, arms R/NULL/C/CH/H, C's logits kept, paired statistics, the rule), its fixture controls, and one frozen run
out: any change to codec/v1 or to CODEC-1's modules and records
H3, other bit widths, per-layer/K-vs-V precision (CODEC-MAP-1)
decode cost (its own rung, after this verdict)

waves.name: instrument
waves.scope: codec_2_run.rs (+ a statistics module) in crates/larql-kv/tests/continuation_mem_1: bank 2 loaded and digest-verified; arms R, NULL, C, CH, H with the CODEC-1 guards and checkpoints (resumable, four authorities); C's decode logits kept per rung; B1 McNemar bound, the stratified block bootstrap (B2 mean, B3 paired p99), B4 in-band McNemar with N_MIN, guard A. Fixture controls with known answers: B1/B4 on hand-built agreement vectors (including a seeded failure just past −δ, and B4 below N_MIN → UNINFORMATIVE); the bootstrap reproducible across runs, matching a closed form on a constant d, and never reweighting rungs (a fixture whose rungs differ by a constant keeps every replicate mean at the rung average); guard A refusing a broken yardstick. No model arm runs in W1
